name: DC motor
summary: A DC motor represents a documented DC electrical load whose armature and any field winding arrangements need to be identified.
description: A DC motor represents a documented DC electrical load whose armature and any field winding arrangements need to be identified. The generic function does not select the excitation method.
readingNotes: Trace armature polarity and the control or starting circuit.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A generic DC motor does not imply permanent-magnet or series-field construction.
